_note: Lines for the farm examine events: the name plate by the farmhouse door and the board on the fence by the gate.

lines.speaker: farmer
lines.text: A cedar name plate by the door. The old owner's name has weathered away to a few faint strokes.

lines.speaker: farmer
lines.text: A cedar name plate by the door. Tsuru said she'd bring her brush... maybe she'll do this one too.
A board nailed to the fence post: 'Village - this way. Mind the slope after rain.'
